checks.summary: 25 API cases and 30 real bootstrap launches rerun after the provenance-only snapshot refresh.

retained_applicability: The final game commit only changes the snapshot source-registry fingerprint after generated roadmap page-review metadata changed. All 82 definitions, schema/content revisions, samples and other snapshot fields are byte-identical. Runtime and tool source files are unchanged from the full seven-suite/54-test/export evidence. Fresh startup and extraction checks pass at delivery revision.

review_checklist.scope_and_contracts: Reviewed: existing validators reused; only explicit fixture/static selection, bootstrap, tests and requested documentation/evidence changed. Canonical definitions and ServerConfiguration unchanged.
review_checklist.ownership_and_maintainability: Reviewed: ContentAdmission owns the single active selection and commit. Fixture adapter owns external file parsing only. Existing scene lifetime and Timer wiring are preserved. No speculative framework/autoload/manager introduced.
review_checklist.types_and_errors: Reviewed: typed results/parameters and explicit dynamic JSON validation; no casts/reflection/warning suppressions or weakened gates. Invalid input yields observable canonical findings before state mutation.
review_checklist.scene_and_security: Reviewed and executed: real headless bootstrap remains two nodes with no client/player scene. No network RPC, persistence or authentication endpoint introduced; peer tests are not applicable.
review_checklist.validation: Passed actual suites, negative controls, Python tests, clean exports/artifact inspection, source-link review, provenance checks and full documentation validation. Local cached-editor failure retained separately.
review_checklist.git_scope: Reviewed: only briarwake and mmo_docs changed on new task branches from fetched main; protected engineering standards and unrelated user work untouched. No merge, deployment, release or force push.

raw_evidence_format: Raw engine output is retained verbatim. git diff --cached --check reports blank EOF lines in 14 banner-only engine logs; these are execution artifacts, not source/test failures. No whitespace/check exclusion or alteration of execution logs was introduced.
